description: Type a password to see its entropy in bits, estimated crack time, and concrete ways to strengthen it.

faqs.a: Entropy = length × log2(character set size). A 16-char password from 94 symbols has ~105 bits.
Assuming 10 billion guesses/second: 2^(bits-1) seconds, shown in human units from seconds to billions of years.
Estimates assume offline attacks. Use a password manager and unique passwords per site regardless of score.
faqs.q: Is a high score a guarantee?

faqs.a: Yes — everything is computed locally; the password never leaves your browser.

howto: Type a password in the field.
Watch entropy, crack time, and the strength bar update live.
Follow the concrete feedback to improve it.
title: Password Strength Meter
